name: Appraiser’s Goggles
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 9th; Slot eyes Weight 1/2 lbs.; Price 18,400 gp

DESCRIPTION

These goggles come complete with several magnifying glasses to aid in inspection of rare and mysterious items. It grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on Appraise checks and Spellcraft checks to identify magic items. Once per day as a move action the wearer can examine a single target within 100 feet, learning its properties as an analyze construction spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, analyze construction; Cost 9,200 gp
